498: SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') AND EXISTS (     SELECT 1     FROM card c     JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id     WHERE d.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE account_id = l.account_id)     AND c.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'     AND c.issued = t.date )
